method: Independently open both Library ZIP archives. For each v140 conflated-node record, look up the matching mountain in the v129 raw topology, scan every edge for start/end node equality with graphNodeId, and compare the resulting set of edge indices to v140 originalEdgeIds. This verifies incident edge references, not original SHP exact coordinate fidelity.
interpretation: v140 node-to-edge indexing matches v129 topology for all 1722 flagged nodes. This is an independently computed cross-archive structural result, not a physical passage validation, exact source SHP endpoint validation, or proof against rounding conflation.
nextStep: Use available v140 per-node records and v129 raw topology to isolate the 114 >5cm nodes by mountain and test source endpoint geometry against SHP; keep 35m candidate edges provisional pending official/legal/field evidence. Audit self-loop geometry against original SHP.
